Hagane - Commander's Office
Colonel Ginto Kitaumi, coming in.
Miles
...Yeah.
Gaspar
Is everyone here now?
Sir!
(Directly from Marshal Gaspar Gilan himself...@This must be quite an important matter.)
...What I have to tell you is this:@how we will deal with Rabulpaila.
There are still over 20 hours left until the@handover deadline. Is this about what comes after?
Yes.@If Gadisword hasn't handed over Rabulpaila@by the deadline, we will launch a certain operation.
Once I'm finished, the Hiryu Custom is to@space transfer to Aviano Base immediately.
...My ship is being taken off its current mission?
That's right.
...Understood.@What should we do once we arrive at the base?
Beneath Aviano Base is a special weapons depot,@and preparations for their use are already underway.
After receiving it, the Hiryu Custom will return@to space and stand ready in case Rabulpaila@fails to comply with the agreement.
And this special weapon is...
A lethal chemical weapon.
So the grace period we gave them was@to prepare a lethal attack...?
They're surely thinking the same way. They won't@just sit idle until the time limit. In preparation,@the Hagane will continue its surveillance.
There are Gadisword civilians on Rabulpaila.@Would you still use chemical weapons?
They may look like us, but they are not Earthlings.@Which means they fall outside Federation law.
B-But...
Legally speaking, using chemical weapons@poses no problem.
...Marshal. I have an opinion to offer as well.@May I?
Go ahead.
Our fleet includes three Gadisword natives@serving as collaborators.
We are also, unofficially,@holding the Princess of the Fury in our custody.
Legally, I believe you are correct, Marshal...@but our fleet has civilian pilots who consider@those aliens their comrades.
If we consider morale in the battles to come,@I too believe we should be cautious@about using chemical weapons.
...I agree.
Hmm...@Brigadier General Miles, is that the consensus@of the Steel Dragons?
...Yes, I share the captains' opinion.
(Commander...)
Oh? That's an unexpected answer.
I came to that judgment after taking a broad@view of the situation.
Nonetheless, we must have several moves in play.@There will be no change to the operation.
However... if Gadisword hands over@Rabulpaila by the deadline, we can@avoid using the chemical weapon.
(That's not very likely.)
Or, if Rabulpaila's leadership, headed by@Herluga Izberga, can be eliminated...
the other Gadisword people may surrender quietly.@If you wish it, I'll authorize a reconnaissance@in force.
Reconnaissance in force...@So engagement is permitted?
Only if they attack first.@Formal or not, this is a ceasefire for negotiations.@I won't have it look like we broke it.
Whether chemical weapons are used on Rabulpaila@depends on the results you deliver.
(Then we could space transfer right next to@the enemy fortress and launch a surprise attack...)
(But that risks exposing us to enemy crossfire,@and if worst came to worst, we couldn't@immediately transfer back out.)
(I should keep space transfer as a trump card.)
In any case, time is short.@I expect prompt execution. That is all.
You heard him, Lieutenant Colonel Lefina.@Take the Hiryu Custom to Aviano Base.
Understood...
However, before departing, transfer all@mobile weapons and pilots to the Hagane.
So you mean to attack Rabulpaila with the@full strength of the Steel Dragons?
It's strictly a reconnaissance in force.@Though we'll be counting on them to strike first.
Commander...
We must achieve results beyond what the Joint@Chiefs expect. After talking so big to me,@you'll have to deliver, Captain Ginto.
Roger.
...So the Hiryu Custom went to Earth?
Yes. It space transferred a little while ago.
I don't get it.@I wouldn't think we could spare that ship.
Could there be some important mission@only the Hiryu Custom can carry out?
But they unloaded the mobile weapons, right?@So what on earth are they...
That's enough. The Commander's here.
We will now hold the briefing on the@reconnaissance in force against Rabulpaila.
We're currently in a ceasefire, but if they@attack in response to our scouting, we'll fight back.
Naturally, since a reconnaissance in force is a@kind of provocation, we're hoping it starts a fight.
Quiet.@The Joint Chiefs don't believe Gadisword will@hand over Rabulpaila before the deadline.
The enemy made thorough preparations and seized@the Cross Gate in a lightning operation.
If they were willing to comply with a handover@demand, they wouldn't have done that to begin with.
And there's no telling when they'll fire the@Zemon Mortar and space transfer away with the@Cross Gate.
The Joint Chiefs are preparing a special weapon@to prevent that, and the Hiryu Custom@has gone to receive it.
That special weapon is a lethal chemical weapon.@It was chosen as a means to swiftly take Rabulpaila@without affecting the Cross Gate.
Fairy
B-But that's...!
Th-That's too much!@There are civilians on Rabulpaila!
That's going way too far!
The safety of enemy noncombatants is secondary.@That's what the military is.
B-But even so...
Dragging in even people who@have no will to fight...!
...So the Hiryu Custom was chosen@for its space transfer device.
To cut the chemical weapon's transport@time as much as possible...
(Now that they know what Herluga's after,@they'll use any means. But...)
Sieg...
If they were set on using chemical weapons,@they'd have kept quiet about it to us Gadisword@folks. So we couldn't interfere.
Which means...
There's still room to avoid it...?
But how?
...We need only end this@with our own hands, and quickly.
Mm, Sänger is right.
B-But it's a reconnaissance in force, right?
Rabulpaila might space transfer before the@chemical weapon arrives. Most likely, the true@aim of this mission is...
...Once the briefing is over,@our fleet will immediately carry out@the reconnaissance in force.
As I said earlier,@if Gadisword attacks, we fight back...
then charge straight into Rabulpaila@and defeat Herluga Izberga.
So basically...
We have to end the war with Gadisword@before the Hiryu Custom gets back?
Then the chemical weapon won't have to be used...?
That's what it means, I'd say.
Then we've got no choice but to do it fast.
Depending on how Gadisword responds, it may be@back-to-back battles with all forces committed.@I'm counting on your efforts. That is all.
Shana-Mia
The Earth forces have such a plan@for Gadisword...
Yeah. We intend to fight so it doesn't happen.
Melua
Um, Shana-Mia, you look pale...
Of course she does. If they'll stoop to an inhumane@attack on Rabulpaila, their next target@could be Gaw-La Furia.
Tenia
Whaaat!?
Katia
Calvina,@we don't know for sure it'll come to that...
It is only natural for those who govern Earth@to put Earth's safety and interests first.
Considering what Gu-Landon has done,@we, the Fury, cannot complain if the people@of Earth condemn us.
But if we keep trading blame like that,@the chain of misfortune will just go on.@We have to break it with our own hands.
There are lots of people sleeping@in the Grove of Time Travel on Gaw-La Furia.@For their sake too, we have to end this fight...
(And Al-Van is on that ship too...)
Like Touya says, I think we've been given the means@and the time to end the wars with the Fury@and with Gadisword.
That's right.@It's cutting it close, but we have to do it.
Thank you, everyone.
(If Herluga Izberga must be defeated@for the sake of peace, then next,@I must face Gu-Landon...)
Bro, if we can stop Herluga and his people,@the fighting will end for sure, won't it...?
Captain Vort will come out before that.@We can't reach Rabulpaila without getting past him.
Vort knows the truth,@and he's still siding with Herluga...
He believes Gadisword's future lies@not with Earth, but in an alliance@with Golaikunru.
But Herluga's ambitions are tangled up in that.@If he gets his hands on the Cross Gate,@they'll only grow bigger.
And Golaikunru means to exploit that.
Yon is trying to mediate between the Zovorg@and Earth, but those people@aren't like that...
Herluga and Golaikunru together are the worst.@There's no telling what they'll pull with@the Cross Gate and Rabulpaila.
Yes... The seeds of conflict could end up@sown even within the Zovorg...
Before that happens, we have to stop Vort...@and Herluga's group, with our own hands.

All mobile units, launch.@But no attacking until ordered.
Yes, sir. All mobile units, launch!
Enemies approaching! From twelve o'clock,@depression 2, straight in!@Entering Range 3 shortly!
(Approaching while slowing down...)
Azuki

Send the approaching enemies a warning: if they@enter our firing range, we'll intercept.@It'll buy a little time and distance.
Roger. Sending a warning to the enemy.
Akimi, among them...
Yeah, the Gyanonia Ogre's there.
(Vort...)
Akemi, among them...
Yes, the Gyanonia Ogre's there.
To the approaching Gadisword units. If you enter@our firing range, we will attack. I repeat.@If you enter our firing range...
Gadisword Soldier

Captain, that's a declaration of attack!
(If they meant to invade from the start, why warn us?@To buy time and distance to the very last?@Or else...)
It's obvious they're planning to invade@Rabulpaila! Permission to attack!
They may be a decoy. We'll see what they do.@All units, don't attack until ordered.
Y-Yes, sir!
(Turn back, Hagane...@All we want is time until the transfer.@Don't provoke Herluga.)
(Fall back, Vort...@The one we should be fighting is Herluga.)
Vort, what are you doing?@Don't let them near Rabulpaila.
Their mission may be a forced recon.@Until preparations are complete, we should avoid@any battle we can...
There's no need for that. Start attacking now.@I'll give you covering fire from here.
...Understood.
Multiple missiles closing fast! Twelve o'clock,@depression 2! Eleven o'clock, depression 4,@straight in! Range 5!
Prepare for anti-air interception!
Rabulpaila fired on us?!
Right!
Captain, hostilities have begun!@Charge Rabulpaila!
Understood.@Attention, all hands. This operation must be@carried out swiftly.
Within the next 360 seconds, this ship will@charge into the space near Rabulpaila.@All mobile units, open a breach.
Let's go, Fairy!
Yes, all right.
Let's go, Fairy!
(So this is truly the last chance.)
To all units.@We are the shield of the people on Rabulpaila.@We cannot fall here.
We needn't annihilate the enemy. Just buy time.@Don't throw your lives away. Commence attack.
Yes, ma'am!
Vort, get out of the way!@Our target is Herluga Izberga!@We came here to stop that man!
And to end the war between@Earth and Gadisword!
There's no turning back now.@We have no choice but to entrust our future@to Herluga.
That man is dangerous!@If he gets the Cross Gate, he'll surely@bring about a great disaster!
Even so, we have no choice but to control@the <Zemon> and coexist with it...
If we are to survive within the vast@interstellar power that is the Zovorg.
...Actively meddling with the Cross Gate@will bring great disaster upon you.
Don't you know what that ultimately leads to?
What do you mean?
Gadisword's home planet...@has already been destroyed, hasn't it?
Vort!
There's nothing more to discuss.@And I won't let you pass beyond this point.@Fairy... not even you.
Ngh...!
That's as good as an answer...!
We're... the last survivors of Gadisword...?!
Sally...
(Was Gadisword's home planet destroyed by@an army of ruin like the Ruina...?)
Then... all the more reason not to let@Herluga do as he pleases...
So that a tragedy like our planet's@never happens again...!
That's right...!@If the Cross Gate falls into <Golaikunru>'s hands,@Earth won't be the only one in danger!
Yes.@In the worst case, it could spark a large-scale@interstellar war.
If that happened,@we of Gadisword would...!
Before that, if they fire a chemical weapon@into Rabulpaila, it's all over.
We won't let them.@There has to be a way to coexist@with the people of Gadisword.
What stands in the way are the ones trying to@use the Cross Gate... Let's stop them@with our own hands.
(If Fureim accepts Touya's will, he may@achieve what we gave up on@in <La Gias>.)
There's no time. All units, begin the assault!
Everyone, please get out of the way!
If we don't stop him,@Gadisword might really be finished!
Please, let us through to Rabulpaila...!@It's dangerous to leave Gadisword's fate@in Herluga's hands!
Both engines ahead, battle speed two.@Cut open a breach!

Attention, all mobile units!@120 seconds left until the time limit!
Attention, all mobile units!@60 seconds left until the time limit!
Attention, all mobile units!@30 seconds left until the time limit!
We're out of time!@Hurry and secure our course and a breach!
The operation's failed...!
How's that?!
Ugh... Ngh...!
If you'd listened to Fairy,@it never would've come to this!
B-But... to restore Gadisword...@Herluga is...
You're saying you can trust Herluga,@but you can't trust Fairy?!
How about that?!
If you'd listened to Fairy,@it never would've come to this!
You're saying you can trust Herluga,@but you can't trust Fairy?!
With that... we're going through, Captain...!
With that... we're going through, Captain...!
...We're going, Vort.
You can't fight in that machine anymore.@We won't take your life.
You'd... show me mercy...?
I just don't want to make Fairy any sadder.@See for yourself that we're trying to help@the Gadisword people in our own way.
Captain, we've opened a breach to Rabulpaila!
Both engines ahead standard.@Have all mobile units latch onto the hull.
Then deploy the energy field in all directions@and charge into Rabulpaila.
Roger. Both engines ahead standard.@To all mobile units: latch onto the ship at once.
Vort, get out of the way!@The one we should be fighting is Herluga!
We mustn't let him or Golaikunru@have the Cross Gate!
...The weak are driven out by the strong.@Gadisword's own history has proven it.
To establish our place among the interstellar@powers, we need great power.
Akimi, Akemi, and the Steel Dragons@accepted Sieg, Sally, and me...!
Even without the Cross Gate or Rabulpaila,@there must be a way for us to live!
That won't restore Gadisword. To avenge our@brethren who shared our planet's fate,@I cannot let you through.
Herluga may have killed my brother!
Fairy, there's no time! We're breaking through!
Don't think you can do it in that machine.
We're powered up with a Siebe Drive!@We'll show you!
Vort, get out of the way!@The one we should be fighting is Herluga!
Fairy, there's no time! We're breaking through!
We're powered up with a Siebe Drive!@We'll show you!
Sieg... You still reject the path to restoration?
If we're the last survivors, then I'll be damned@before I trust Gadisword's future@to Herluga!
Cast aside your personal feelings.@And understand that the side we should take@is not Earth's, but Golaikunru's.
I trust them even less than Herluga!@And I've got no intention of clinging@to something like the Cross Gate!
Sally... There's no future in siding@with the Earthlings.
I don't believe that! Just like Fairy said,@Akimi, Akemi, and the others@accepted us!
So the people on Rabulpaila will be too, I'm sure!
And what would that achieve? Can the weak@Earthlings guarantee Gadisword's future?
It's better than trusting our fate to the Cross Gate!@Using a thing like that will only bring disaster!
I'm going to Rabulpaila to prevent that!
Rabulpaila Control Room
Tch, that Vort... How pathetic.
Operator
The Hagane is recovering its units and@moving onto an attack course toward us.
Prepare to fire the Zemon Mortar.
You're firing it now...?!
We need a test firing anyway.@Gomoudokka requested one as well.
I'll show that man and the Earthlings the power@of the Zemon Mortar, the fruit of my research.
But calibration isn't finished yet...!
No matter. Fire it at the Hagane at minimum output.
There are pilots in the line of fire who ejected@after being shot down by the Steel Dragons...
I said no matter.
R-roger!
Rabulpaila is making a sharp course change!@It looks like it's lining up the Zemon Mortar's@line of fire with the Hagane's attack course!
